items.title: DALL·E 2: Extending creativity
items.summary: As part of our DALL·E 2 research preview, more than 3,000 artists from more than 118 countries have incorporated DALL·E into their creative workflows. The artists in our early access group have helped us discover new uses for DALL·E and have served as key voices as we’ve made decisions about DALL·E’s features.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI公布了DALL·E 2研究预览进展，来自118个国家的3000多名艺术家将其融入创意工作流，为功能决策提供了宝贵反馈。
